BIRTHDAY GREETINGS 
 
SHRI PRAMOD TIWARI  (Rajasthan): Hon’ble Chairman Sir, I would like to talk about 
Hathras before you ...(Interruptions)..  
 
MR. CHAIRMAN: Pramod ji , this is engaging my attention. I will be talking about it. I 
have taken note of it. 
Hon. Members, I extend Birthday Greetings to hon. M embers of Parliament, 
Dr. K. Laxman and Shri Harbhajan Singh. 
 Dr. K. Laxman is Member of this august House since  July, 2022. He has rich 
and varied experience in public life. Having repres ented Musheerabad twice – first in 
the Eleventh Andhra Pradesh Legislative Assembly fr om 1999 to 2004 and later in the 
First Telangana Legislative Assembly from 2014 to 2 018, he was the Floor Leader of 
the BJP from 2014 to 2016 in Telangana Assembly. He  is currently the National 
President of his party’s OBC Morcha. A doctorate in  Geology from Osmania 
University, Dr. Laxman has always advocated and cha mpioned the welfare of 
marginalized.   
 He has a deep passion for sports, was a league-lev el cricketer and volleyball 
player. He is actively involved in Telangana and An dhra Pradesh Olympic 
Associations. Married to Smt. Kova Uma, the couple is blessed with daughters, 
Shweta and Shruti and son Rahul. 
I join this House to wish Dr. K. Laxman the best of  health and happiness and 
extend greetings to his family members. 
Shri Harbhajan Singh, known for his off-spin in cri cket, is a Member of this 
House since 2022.  He is amongst the top three off- spinners and regarded as one of 
the best bowlers in his area. 
Shri Harbhajan Singh, the Turbanator, played a pivo tal role in India’s victory in 
T20 World Cup in 2007 and ODI World Cup in 2011. Ju st within three years of his 
debut, he claimed the historic test hat-trick again st Australia in 2001. With his 103 
Test Matches, 236 One Day Internationals and severa l T20 matches, Shri Harbhajan 
Singh has left a truly inspirational legacy. He was  honoured with the Arjuna Award in 

 
2003 and conferred the Civilian Award, Padma Shri, in 2009 by the Government of 
India.  Married to Smt. Geeta Basra, the couple is blessed with daughter, Hinaya, 
and son Jovan.  I join this House to wish Shri Harb hajan Singh and his family the best 
of health and happiness and extend greetings to his family members. 
 
 
OBITUARY REFERENCE 
 
MR. CHAIRMAN: Hon. Members, I refer with profound s orrow to the passing away of 
a former Member of this House, Shri Dharmapuri Srinivas , on 29 th  June, 2024. 
 Shri D. Srinivas, a three-term Member of the Andhr a Pradesh Legislative 
Assembly, a Cabinet Minister in the State, as also the Leader of the Opposition in the 
Legislative Council, served in this House, represen ting the State of Telangana, from 
2016 to 2022. Born on 27 th  September, 1948, at Velpur in Nizamabad district o f 
Telangana, Shri Dharmapuri Srinivas dedicated his l ife to the upliftment of backward 
and deprived sections of the society. In the passing away of Shri Dharmapuri Srinivas, 
the country has lost a veteran legislator, a champi on of the backward classes and an 
able administrator. We deeply mourn the passing awa y of Shri Dharmapuri Srinivas. I 
request the Members to rise in their places and obs erve silence as a mark of respect 
to the memory of the departed. 
 
(Hon. Members then stood in silence for one minute .) 
 
MR. CHAIRMAN: Secretary-General will convey to the members of the bereaved 
family our sense of profound sorrow and deep sympathy. 
 
 
REFERENCE BY THE CHAIR 
 
Stampede at a religious event at Hathras, Uttar Pradesh 
 
MR. CHAIRMAN: Hon. Members, as you are aware, sever al devotees lost lives in a 
stampede that broke out at a religious event at Hat hras in Uttar Pradesh. The loss of 
precious lives and injury to hapless persons in this tragic incident is indeed painful and 
unfortunate. All necessary steps are being taken to  provide medical aid to the injured 
and authorities have set up a committee to investig ate the matter. This House joins 
me in expressing our heartfelt condolences as well as deep sympathy and sorrow to 
2
[RAJYA SABHA]

 
the bereaved families and in praying for the speedy  recovery of the injured. I request 
hon. Members to rise in their places and observe si lence as a mark of respect to the 
memory of those who lost their lives in this tragedy. 
 
(Hon. Members then stood in silence for one minute .) 
 
SHRI PRAMOD TIWARI  (Rajasthan): Sir, one second… Sir tell me that… 
 
Mr. CHAIRMAN: I have taken note of it. Hon. Members , this is an aspect on which 
this House should deliberate in a structured manner  so that all over the country  
where there are places where people gather for fair s, for religious purposes or similar 
social activities, there is a structured mechanism in place so that the administration at 
district level all over the country is sensitized. I had reflected on this when I addressed 
the Indian Institute of Public Administration. I wo uld personally welcome inputs from 
Members as to what can be done in this direction an d, in the next session, we will 
work to evolve a mechanism so that such events are avoided because these events 
are avoidable. I am sure the House will take note of it.  We will have it next time.

than 100 per cent in our productivity.

democratic values.
